title: "Comparison of ChIP-seq motif enrichment for quantitative scores vs binary presence-absence"
output: html_document
----------------------
  
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
options(scipen = 20)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

Map TF names to motif IDs
```{r define-tfs}
tfs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~tf_name,       ~motif_id,
  "ZmTF117_ereb17", "MA1818.1",
  "ZmTFLG2_lg2",    "MA1835.2",
  "ZmTF58_glk53",   "MA1830.2",
  "ZmTF87_bhlh47",  "MA1834.2",
  "ZmTF174_hb34",   "MA1824.2"
)
```

Process fimo output for each TF/motif, calculating enrichment within empirical and shuffled ChIP-seq regions
```{r process-combos}
process_combo <- function(tf_name, motif_id) {
  base <- file.path("/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/output/quant_motif_comparison/chip_fimoDefault", tf_name, "fimo")
  emp_file <- file.path(base, "empirical_fimo", paste0(motif_id, ".fimo.txt")) # Empirical regions
  bg_file  <- file.path(base, "bg_fimo",        paste0(motif_id, ".fimo.txt")) # Dinucleotide-shuffled regions
  
  df_emp <- data.table::fread(emp_file) %>% as.data.frame()
  df_bg  <- data.table::fread(bg_file)  %>% as.data.frame()
  
  # Count-based enrichment
  emp_count <- nrow(df_emp)
  bg_counts <- df_bg %>%
    mutate(copy_id = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(sequence_name, "(?<=shuf_)\\d+"))) %>% # Extract iteration number
    group_by(copy_id) %>%
    summarise(n_motifs = n()) # Count how many motifs were present in each iteration
  fit_c    <- fitdistrplus::fitdist(bg_counts$n_motifs, "norm") # Fit normal distribution to shuffled counts
  fc_count <- emp_count / fit_c$estimate["mean"] # Calculate fold change between empirical and shuffled
  
  # Score-based enrichment
  emp_score <- sum(df_emp$score)
  bg_scores <- df_bg %>%
    mutate(copy_id = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(sequence_name, "(?<=shuf_)\\d+"))) %>%
    group_by(copy_id) %>%
    summarise(total_score = sum(score))
  fit_s <- fitdist(bg_scores$total_score, "norm")
  fc_score  <- emp_score / fit_s$estimate["mean"]
  
  tibble::tibble(
    tf_name,
    motif_id,
    fold_change_count = fc_count,
    fold_change_quant = fc_score
  )
}

results_df <- purrr::pmap_dfr(tfs, process_combo)
```

```{r plot-fold-changes}
plot_df <- results_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("fold_change_"),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "fold_change"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type,
                       fold_change_count = "Count-based",
                       fold_change_quant = "Score-based"))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = tf_name, x = fold_change, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  labs(y = "TF",
       x = "Fold-change enrichment (ChIP vs shuffled background)",
       fill = "",
       title = "ChIP-seq enrichment comparison for motif counts vs. motif scores") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
